paite: Huai khit in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Kuan inla, hiai a kipan paitou in, nang leh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak mite, na suante kiang ah ka hon pe ding, chi a, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ka kichiamna gam ah.
heading: TOUPA'N Sinai Tang Nuse Ding In Israelte Thu Apia
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

paite: Na ma ah ka angel ka sawl ding a; huchi in Kanaante, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding.
english: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

paite: Bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ah hohtou un. Migenhakte na hih ziak un, kei na lak ua hohtou lou ding ka hi. Huchi lou in zaw lampi ah ka hon kangtum kha ding," achi hi.
english: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

paite: Mite'n hiai thuhoih lou azak un, alungkham uhi. Huchi in mi kuamah kizepna a kizem a-om kei uh.
english: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

paite: TOUPA'N lah Mosi kiang ah, "Israel suante kiang ah, migenhakte na hi uhi. Mitphiat kal lou a na lak ua hong tou a, hong kangtum thei ka hi. Huaiziak in na tung ua bang hih ding ka hia, chih ka theihna ding in na kizepnate uh suahkhia un," chi in ana gen khinta hi.
english: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n Horeb tang ah akizepnate uh asuahkhe vek uhi.
english: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

paite: Mosi in puanin asut a, giahphual polam, giahphual a pan gamlapi ah akai a, Kihoupihna Biakbuk, achi hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, michih TOUPA zongte kihoupihna biakbuk, giahphual polam a om ah ahoh uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin
english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought Yahweh went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin lam a Mosi apaikhiak teng in, mite avek un adingh ua, michih apuanin kongkhak bul ah adingh ua; puanin a alut mateng Mosi a-enzui uhi.
english: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin a Mosi alutleh, meipi khuam ahong kumsuk a, puanin kongkhak bul ah adingh a, huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupihta hi.
english: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.

paite: Mi tengteng in puanin kongkhak bul a dingh, meipi khuam amu uhi. Mi tengteng adingh ua abia uhi; michih in apuanin kongkhak chiat ah.
english: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

paite: Mi'n alawm ahoupih bang in, TOUPA'N kimaituah in Mosi ahoupih hi. Huchi in giahphual ah akik nawn a, himahleh asikha Joshua, Nun tapa, tangval nou ahihleh puanin a pan apaikhe kei hi.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "En in, hiai mite hon pitou in na hon chi a, himahleh ka kiang a kua hon sawl ding na hia chih na hon theisak kei hi. Hinapi in lah, na min in ka hon thei a, ka mitmuh in hehpihna leng na mu hi, na chi hi.
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Ompih Achiam
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka hon ngen ahi. Na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, nang ka hon theihna ding leh na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhtheihna ding in, tu in na lampi hon ensak in. Hiai nam na mite ahi, chih ngaihtuah in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka ompihna nang toh aton dia, khawlna ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Na ompihna kei toh aton kei dingleh, hiai a pan hon pitou ke'n.
english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

paite: N'on tonpih keileh, bangchi in na mite leh ke'n na mitmuh in deihsakna ka mu uh chih kithei ding ahia? Leitung pumpi a teng mi tengteng a pan kei leh na mite atuam ka hi uh, chih bang in akichiansak dia?" achi hi.
english: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ka mitmuh in deihsakna na mu a, na min in ka hon theita a, hiai na nget pen leng ka hon hihsak ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka hon ngen hi, na thupina hon ensak in," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na ma ah ka hoihna tengteng ka paisak dia, na ma ah TOUPA min ka tangkoupih ding. 'Ka hehpih nopmi, ka hehpih dia, zahngaihna ka lah nopmi kiang ah zahngaihna ka lak ding,' achi hi.
english: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

paite: Himahleh ka mai na mu thei kei ding; mi, kei hon mu, ahing kuamah a-om louh ziak in.
english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

paite: TOUPA'N, 'En in, hiai ah ka kiang ah mun khat a-om a; suangpi tung ah na dingh in.
english: Yahweh also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, ka thupina in hon khen sung in suangpi heng ah ka hon koih dia, ka hon khen sung in ka khut in ka hon khuh ding hi.
english: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

paite: Huai khit chiang in ka khut ka lakhe dia, huchi in ka nunglam na mu dia; himahleh ka mai bel akimu kei ding, " achi hi.
english: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
